events.title: Rock n Roll Tribute Show with Tommy Memphis
events.location: Sunshine Coast Function Centre, Caloundra RSL
events.description: Tommy Memphis performs a high-energy tribute show featuring classic rock and roll hits. Expect a nostalgic musical performance tailored for an intimate function setting.

events.title: Every Breath You Take and Atomic-Oz
events.description: A live music showcase featuring the music of The Police via tribute act Every Breath You Take, supported by Atomic-Oz. Held at a dedicated local music venue known for supporting live bands.

events.title: Bach to Billie
events.description: An eclectic musical program presented by the Sunshine Coast Choral Society ranging from the classical compositions of Bach to the jazz stylings of Billie Holiday. This event highlights the versatility of local choral performance.

events.title: Acoustic Guitar Spectacular
events.location: Eudlo Public Hall and Recreation Grounds, Eudlo
events.description: A showcase of virtuoso guitar talent featuring diverse styles and techniques performed in the rustic setting of the Eudlo Public Hall. The event focuses on the artistry and technical mastery of acoustic instrumentation.

events.title: Charlie Ivan Band Of Nothing Tour
events.description: Charlie Ivan performs as part of his 'Band Of Nothing' tour at the Mapleton Public House. An intimate afternoon set suitable for a local pub atmosphere.
